title: Gimme Shelter Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Gimme Shelter is a 2.00 bedroom, 2.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: 12 BUTLER STREETWelcome to Gimme ShelterTucked away in a quiet corner of Seaside, Florida, Gimme Shelter is a beautifully renovated two-bedroom beach cottage just a three-minute walk to the beach and steps from the Westside Family Pool. Designed for comfort and coastal ease, this charming retreat is ideal for couples or small families seeking a relaxing escape in one of 30A’s most beloved communities. Inspired by the iconic Rolling Stones song, this home offers a peaceful hideaway with all the conveniences of modern living.Outdoor Living & ArrivalFollow a shaded footpath through lush landscaping to reach this inviting cottage, where a private, fenced yard and cozy front porch set the tone for relaxation. The porch features bistro seating—perfect for morning coffee or unwinding after a day at the beach. Surrounded by greenery, the outdoor space feels both private and serene, creating an immediate sense of retreat.Main Level | Private Bedroom SuitesThe first floor is home to two spacious king bedrooms, each offering privacy and comfort. Both suites feature updated ensuite bathrooms with spa-inspired finishes. One bathroom includes a glass-enclosed tub and shower combination with a rain head and handheld wand, while the second offers a sleek walk-in glass shower. Each bedroom is outfitted with a wall-mounted flat-screen TV and thoughtful storage, creating a boutique hotel feel throughout.Upper Level | Living, Dining & KitchenUpstairs, the open-concept living space is designed for gathering and relaxation. A large sectional sofa, plush club chairs, and an Apple TV with Sonos surround sound make this space perfect for movie nights or lounging after a beach day. The adjacent dining area comfortably seats four, while the updated kitchen features custom cabinetry, a full refrigerator, microwave, compact dishwasher, and a four-burner electric cooktop—everything you need for easy coastal cooking.Balcony & Outdoor AmenitiesStep outside to the second-floor covered balcony, where outdoor dining for four and peaceful treetop views create the perfect setting for sunset cocktails or alfresco meals. At the rear of the home, guests will find a private outdoor shower and a gas grill—ideal for post-beach rinses and casual cookouts.Thoughtful Extras for a Seamless StayGimme Shelter includes thoughtful conveniences such as two complimentary bikes for exploring Seaside, a washer and dryer, Apple TV, and a Sonos sound system throughout. Every detail is designed to make your stay effortless, comfortable, and memorable.Whether you're seeking a romantic escape, a laid-back family getaway, or a peaceful coastal retreat, Gimme Shelter delivers the perfect blend of location, style, and relaxation—just steps from the best of Seaside, Florida.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Fall & Winter | 5-night minimum SummerFEATURES1,200 square feet176 yards or a 3-minute walk to beach accessSeaside residential beach at West Ruskin Pavilion, the largest private beach on 30AHigh-speed internet and Apple TVWasher & dryerGas grillOutdoor showerPeacock Alley Linens – Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley sheets and towels throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided2 parking passes are issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002084
